# Aryn

Aryn is an AI-powered platform for document parsing, data extraction, and analytics, enabling users to process and query unstructured documents at scale.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/aryn/.

## Actions

- **Create DocSet**: Create a new docset.
- **Create DocSet**: Create a new docset.
- **Delete DocSet**: Delete a docset and all its documents.
- **Generate plan**: Generate a query plan without executing it.
- **Get DocSet Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve metadata for a specific docset.
- **Get Document Binary** (read-only): Retrieve the binary content of a document by docset id and document id.
- **Get Document by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a document by id.
- **List Async Tasks** (read-only): List all outstanding asynchronous tasks for the account.
